details.name: Bio Visage Detox & Remodeling Mansard Facial Treatment
details.description: Bio Visage is the cornerstone of a conceptual approach designed to deliver results beyond expectations. This exclusively professional, technology-driven concentrate normalizes skin function without damaging or dehydrating tissue. Through a precise synergy of specialized currents and active botanical extracts, it restores cellular activity and regulates vital skin functions. The complexion is instantly brightened by advanced oxygenation, visibly reducing redness and dark circles. By providing a gentle lifting effect, Bio Visage restores contractility to every muscle fiber—leaving the face completely restructured, firmer, and radiantly luminous.

details.description: Deep cellular rejuvenation and contouring ,an advanced, non-invasive skin treatment that combines  up to eight high-tech modalities such as diamond microdermabrasion, negative pressure/ lymphatic drenage, oxygen infusion & Ionized mist, ultrasound therapy , microcurrent & radiofrequency, LED light therapy   An expression of exceptional to lift, tone and brighten the skin with zero downtime.

details.name: Regenerative Facial Treatment
details.description: Regenerative  facial treatment utilizes lymphatic drenage massage, LED light in conjunction with topical infusion of collagen fibers, soluble collagen peptides and molecules along with regenerative products such as exosomes to provide an optimal environment for healing, tissue remodelling and regeneration.   Who can benefit from: Post surgery, laser treatments, chemical peels, burns, severe retinoid reactions.
